scientific_integrity: Symbolic finite-dimensional spectral and convexity proof; standalone deterministic rational checks supplement rather than replace proof. No independent mathematical audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Exact fixed iid single-coordinate minimization of SPD quadratics with the specified positive-correlation friendship matrices only. The theorem concerns sharp one-step expected squared energy, not adaptive or finite-horizon policy. Independent specialist publication-priority review not performed; possibility of older equivalent E-optimal-design result remains.
title: Sharp two-phase optimal coordinate sampling on positive-correlation friendship matrices
